test_title: PYST 56: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Lily __has dedicate__ her life towards becoming a doctor.
solution:
The correct answer is: **has dedicated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense**.
 
• The present perfect tense is formed with **"has"** or **"have"** followed by the **past participle** of the **verb**. 
 
 
• **For example:** Vinay **has moved** into a new apartment.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in the given question, after **'has'**, the **past participle form of the verb **(dedicated) must be used.
 
• Hence, **'has dedicated'** is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *Lily **has dedicated**__ her life towards becoming a doctor.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The rest of the options are **incorrect** because:

 
 
• **'had dedicate': **This is an attempt to form a past perfect tense ("had dedicated") but fails as it uses the base form **"dedicate"** instead of the past participle "dedicated." The correct past perfect form would be "had dedicated," but in this sentence, past perfect is not appropriate as we are talking about an action impacting the present.
 
• 
 **'is dedicate'**: This option incorrectly attempts to construct a present tense using **"is"** (a present form of "to be") with "dedicate." The correct present tense formation would involve using "is dedicating" if we wanted to depict an ongoing action; however, the intended meaning is about a commitment that spans past to present, making the present perfect tense ("has dedicated") more appropriate.
